source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 按截图网格估读气泡大小和颜色，非原始表达矩阵
provenance.en: Bubble radii and colors were estimated on the screenshot grid, not recovered from an expression matrix.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 基因 × 细胞/细胞核表达矩阵，细胞类型标注，以及基因所属 Early/Intermediate/Late 分组。
归一化/对数/缩放方法，表达大于 0 的阈值、每组分母和缺失值处理。
对每个 gene × cell_type 计算平均表达及阳性百分比；当前脚本接收这两项汇总。
en: Gene-by-cell/nucleus expression matrix, cell-type annotations and Early/Intermediate/Late gene groups.
Normalization/log/scaling method, expression-positive threshold, per-group denominator and missing-value handling.
Compute mean expression and percent positive for each gene × cell_type; the renderer accepts these summaries.

preprocessing.zh: 先从表达矩阵计算 gene × cell_type 汇总，expression 为指定归一化后的均值，percent 为 0–100 的阳性百分比。代码不负责单细胞归一化。
preprocessing.en: Aggregate gene × cell_type upstream. expression is the mean under the chosen normalization; percent is 0–100 percent positive. The code does not perform single-cell normalization.

description.zh: 基因名称；与样式中的基因顺序一致
细胞类型；与样式顺序一致
指定归一化方式下的平均表达；非原始计数
description.en: Mean expression under stated normalization, not raw counts

description.zh: 阳性细胞百分比；控制气泡面积
description.en: Percent positive cells; controls bubble area
